settings.title: Send photos
settings.body: Fill the form below with clear photos of what you have.

settings.title: We value it
settings.body: We check live market prices and send you an offer, usually within a day.

settings.title: You accept
settings.body: Take cash, or extra value as store credit. No pressure either way.

settings.title: Get paid
settings.body: Meet us at a show, or ship it in and we pay on arrival.

settings.yes_list:
Singles — modern and vintage, any condition
Graded slabs — PSA, CGC, BGS, TAG
Sealed — boxes, ETBs, packs, tins
Bulk lots and whole collections
Magic and One Piece, too
settings.no_list:
Proxies, fakes or reprints sold as real
Water-damaged or mouldy bulk
Opened product missing its contents
settings.no_footnote: Not sure? Send it anyway and we'll tell you honestly.
